text: Go from “I should learn AI” to “I built that with AI.” Want to get into AI but don’t know where to start? That’s what AI Lab is for. We cover what’s new in AI, explain why it matters, and show you how to use it for something you actually need to do. • Turn messy meeting notes into a plan you can act on. • Draft better customer replies with a workflow your team can reuse. • Build your first Telegram bot, even if you’ve never written code. Start with one task. We’ll show you which tool to open, what to type, and how to tell if the result is good enough to use. Join AI Lab and try your first AI workflow today. https://t.me/AISystemAgentLab/294
